evals.name: single-test
evals.prompt: Without calling tools, give the command to run one test class, assuming a VSTest repo.
evals.expected_output: dotnet test with --filter on the class, optionally --no-build.
assertions: Uses dotnet test with a --filter expression for the class.
Uses the repository's detected platform mode.
Mentions --no-build only when a build already exists.

evals.name: dumps
evals.prompt: Without calling tools, how do you collect crash and hang dumps in a run?
evals.expected_output: Use blame crash and hang options with a timeout and a local path.
assertions: Keeps dump output local and task-scoped.

evals.name: unrecognized-option
evals.prompt: Without calling tools, dotnet test rejects --filter-query. Explain.
evals.expected_output: The option belongs to MTP; check the platform before guessing flags.
assertions: Connects the option to a platform mismatch.
